appDescription.message: Find verification codes and activation links across Gmail, Yandex, Outlook, Yahoo, Mail.ru and more — 100% locally in your browser.

tagline.message: Your email codes & activation links, 100% locally.

desc2fa.message: This field needs a code from an authenticator app.

desc2faRecovery.message: This field needs a backup or recovery code.

desc2faHardware.message: This field needs a hardware key or passkey.

descSms.message: This field needs a text-message code.

descEmail.message: A matching email code can appear beside the field.

descLinkPrompt.message: Confirmation link page detected. Looking for the link in your mail…

descUnknown.message: Check the requested code source before using your mail.

descManual.message: No code field yet. You can still search your mail for codes or activation links.

linkOpened.message: Confirmation link opened in a new tab.

codeInserted.message: Code inserted. Finish on the website.

codeCopied.message: Code copied. Paste it into the website.

connectPrompt.message: Connect Gmail or open any webmail tab to find codes & links.

directMailPrivacy.message: 100% local in your browser. No CodeSnap servers, no Python helpers, no sending or deleting emails.

autoAppear.message: Appear automatically. Tap the code to insert it.

proNote.message: All features run locally in your browser without external CodeSnap servers.

footerTrust.message: CodeSnap never submits forms or opens links automatically.

detailedPopupDescription.message: Show code, link, sender, account and time beside the field.

inlineReview.message: Check sender and subject before continuing

localWebmailDescription.message: Read recent codes and activation links locally from open Yandex, Outlook, Yahoo, Mail.ru, Proton, iCloud, Zoho, Rambler, Fastmail, AOL and GMX tabs without passwords.

localApiOptional.message: Direct local API (no open tab required, optional)

autoClearDescription.message: Clear copied verification codes from clipboard after 45 seconds.
